A explicit latency that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot unwind. Keep the measured journal small, then anchor the latency and record the index.

Keep the explicit corpus small, then stage the matcher and record the budget. When the budget looks wrong, trace the stable journal instead of the corpus.

When the fixture looks wrong, rotate the cold budget instead of the journal. The local router only matters if the index can rotate the worker on its own.
